name: 62249 · Highland, IL
findings: ZIP 62249 (Highland) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62249 (Highland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
